gloss: in order; one by one; in sequence

definitions.gloss: in order; one by one; in sequence; in turn
definitions.explanation: Following a set order or sequence, dealing with things one at a time from first to last.

examples.japanese: {順|じゅん}に⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧{順|じゅん}に⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: To call names in numerical order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つずつ→一つずつ：24348_hitotsuzutsu⟧{順|じゅん}に⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'll explain things one by one in order, so please save questions for the end.

notes:
The noun ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order/sequence) combined with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to function as an adverb meaning 'in order.' Extremely common in daily life, from queuing to following instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順|じゅん}に⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in order
- {順|じゅん}に⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call in order
- {順|じゅん}に⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain in order
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{順|じゅん}に: from the top, in order
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{順|じゅん}に: in order from largest

USAGE:
Often combined with a criterion: ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧{順|じゅん}に (in numerical order), ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧{順|じゅん}に (in order of age), ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧{順|じゅん}に (in order of arrival). The criterion + {順|じゅん}に pattern is very productive.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in turn — emphasizes taking turns among people
- ⟦{順々|じゅんじゅん}→順々：04007_junjun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: one after another — emphasizes the sequential, continuing nature
- ⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: one after another — faster pace; less about order, more about rapid succession
